company.name: Subsets
company.shortDescription: Subsets is an artificial intelligence company that offers an AI-driven lifecycle growth platform for B2C subscription businesses.
company.description:
Subsets uses AI to automate lifecycle growth experiments in subscription businesses. We help increase retention and lifetime value by enabling commercial teams to create AI-driven experiments and automations, without engineering support.

It was founded in 2022 and is located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables subscription businesses to run AI-based retention experiments and measure their impact on subscriber lifetime value, renewal rates, and engagement.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Driven Retention Experimentation Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI feature that automatically identifies at-risk subscriber groups and explains behavioral signals driving churn.
productsAndServices.name: Explainable AI Audience Generation

productsAndServices.description: A system that tracks and reports the impact of retention experiments on key metrics like lifetime value, renewal rates, and user engagement.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Reporting and Analytics

productsAndServices.description: Infrastructure enabling advanced A/B testing on dynamic subscriber cohorts with statistical significance.
productsAndServices.name: Experimental Infrastructure for A/B Testing

productsAndServices.description: Capability to activate AI predictions and audience segments directly within customer relationship management and email service provider platforms.
productsAndServices.name: Integration with CRM and ESP Systems
